leadIn: By the end of this lesson, learners will be able to:
objectives: Import ReactDOM from 'react-dom' to access portal creation functionality.
Construct a portal component that accepts children and a target DOM element ID as props.
Use document.getElementById() to retrieve the target DOM element for portal mounting.
Implement conditional rendering to handle cases where the target DOM element doesn't exist.
Apply ReactDOM.createPortal() to render children into a different DOM subtree.
Define TypeScript interfaces to type-check portal component props with children and target element ID.
Utilize the portal component within a parent component's JSX structure.
Control CSS styling by applying styles directly to portal content for proper positioning.
Handle event bubbling by understanding how portal events propagate to React parent components.
Return portal content wrapped in React.Fragment when the target element is available.
Modify existing React applications to incorporate portal functionality for modal dialogs or tooltips.
Compare portal rendering with regular React component rendering to understand DOM structure differences.
